jobs.title: Hera Hero
jobs.descriptionHtml:
This is not a typical social work or nursing role. If you've felt that traditional healthcare roles have a ceiling on you, and you want to actually bridge the gaps for older adults after they leave the office or facility, Hera is for you.

An older adult gets discharged from the hospital and you already know they'll be back in 30 days. A family leaves overwhelmed, clutching a stack of papers with numbers they'll never get through. You did everything you could within the system and it still wasn't enough. We started Hera because we felt the system was letting down the generation that raised us.

Hera is dedicated care management in the community for older adults, covered by Medicare. Every family gets matched with a dedicated Hero, you, who actually has the tools, time, and autonomy to help. It’s not a 15 min monthly check-in call. It’s real, ongoing support where you see things through and families call you their Hero.

Why Heroes tell us this feels different

  • Autonomy to manage your own client load: you own your families to give them the care they deserve instead of hoping for the best

  • Remote work from home, set your own flexible schedule

  • Delightful technology built for you so you can focus on fostering connection with families, not fighting an EMR

  • You're never alone on a case with supportive training and community of other Heroes

  • No ceiling on you. We're early stage and growing fast, Heroes joining now are shaping the company.

The Role

  • 1099, 30–40 hrs/week in business hours EST (you set your schedule)

  • $40–60 / hour: factors include experience, geography, and client load

  • Serve older adults and their families in aging at home safely

You'd be a great fit if you are

  • Hold an LMSW, LCSW, or RN (not required but a plus)

  • Have experience in geriatric care management, hospice, palliative care, discharge planning, rehab, or hospital social work

  • Love fostering connection with older adults and their families

  • Are a creative problem solver who wants a job that looks different every day

  • Are tech-savvy and excited by quickly evolving environments and leveraging AI to supercharge your work

  • Remote - must be located in the United States


We’re on a mission to change the way we care for our parents and redefine a universal human experience.
Watch our launch video here.

jobs.title: Founding GTM
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Hera

Every complex system in America has a profession whose job it is to be your trusted guide. You have a lawyer for legal. An accountant for taxes. A financial advisor for your money. Healthcare, a trillion-dollar industry that’s arguably the most complex and touches every single family, leaves us on our own.

Hera is creating a new profession in healthcare: the Hero, a dedicated senior care expert for your family. Our Heroes educate, coordinate, and advocate for the most vulnerable population in the healthcare system — covered by insurance, so every family in America that needs us can access us.

We are in the business of trust. Hera’s brand promise is simple: care that would only be great enough for our own parents. We deliver this at scale by pairing Heroes, trust-building humans, with Juno, their AI teammate. This promise is our moat. It’s what physicians refer to, families buy, what Heroes deliver, and what the product must unlock and enforce at every touchpoint.

How we meet our families

We meet our families through the most trusted referral, from their doctor. Geriatricians and social workers at NYU Langone, Weill Cornell, and Mount Sinai refer families to Hera and these partners introduce us to two or three more organically. Departments reach out unprompted. We show up in health system newsletters we didn't pitch.

Why? Because most care for an older adult happens after they leave the doctor's office. The physicians and social workers who know this don't have the bandwidth to bridge that gap themselves. Hera takes that work off their plate, does it better, and closes the loop back to them. That's why they refer.


Early wins

  • Organic 3x quarter-over-quarter growth in new patient referrals

  • Viral community moments: we organized an art show for an 88-year-old Hera family member that landed NY1, the Chelsea Reporter, and an inbound from NBC.

  • Unprompted inbound from health systems: partners are finding us without a single cold outreach.


What this role is

You'll be Hera's first GTM hire, starting where we already have traction: health system partnerships. You’ll deeply understand how referrals actually happen so you can build the engine that makes them happen at scale.

Today our motion is entirely bottoms-up: a social worker or doctor starts referring, brings us to their supervisor, we do an in-service, and it spreads from there. You'll pour fuel on that motion while also building the top-down relationships — department heads, CMOs, population health leaders — that unlock institutional partnerships at a different scale.

  • Build the health system referral engine. Turn organic partnerships into a repeatable, scalable motion: mapping stakeholders, systematizing outreach, deepening existing relationships, and dramatically increasing referral volume and retention. Map the buyer and influencer personas across acute, post-acute, and ambulatory settings: who refers, who champions, who blocks, and what each cares about so we can tailor our pitch, materials, and product to each. You'll identify the next frontier, new facilities and specialties to pursue, run pilots, and prove or kill each channel.

  • Shape the product. Physicians lose visibility the moment a patient walks out the door. We're building a shared operating picture that meets them where they are in EPIC and bridges clinical data and data on the patient in the community — so Hera becomes infrastructure they can't live without.

  • Hire and lead a field sales team. Healthcare is local. Every market is a separate launch. You'll hire people who own their territory end-to-end, define the playbook, and build the team to run it.


Join our founding team

We closed a sizable seed round led by Accel and have since gotten to seven-figure GMV on organic distribution alone. The customer feedback is the most positive our team has seen in our careers.

You’ll build Hera alongside co-founders Jenny, Myles & Connie as well as founding team members Isabella and Sasi. Jenny, Connie, & Isabella were in the trenches together building Headway (now the largest mental health platform in America) while Myles, Sasi & Connie all came from Palantir, resonating with a personal tie to this mission.

The playbook doesn’t exist yet. You’ll have high autonomy and a team that has your back when you run at hard problems that force you to find your edges.

We are in person in NYC. Read our story and watch our launch video here.

If this speaks to you, let's talk: jenny@hellohera.com

jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The gap no one has filled

Every complex system in America has a profession whose job it is to be your trusted guide and expert. You have a lawyer for legal. An accountant or Turbotax for taxes. A financial advisor for your money. A travel agent or Expedia for your trip. Healthcare, a trillion-dollar industry that’s arguably the most complex and touches every single family, leaves us on our own.

Hera is creating a new profession in healthcare: the Hero — a dedicated senior care expert for your family. They focus on the “last mile” of healthcare.

Our Heroes educate, coordinate, and advocate for the most vulnerable and most expensive population to the healthcare system.

  • Not just getting a kidney transplant, but getting Barbara to her follow up appointment to keep her out of the hospital again.

  • Not just getting the home aide in place, but ensuring they’re taking care of Beverly the right way.

  • Not just bringing John home from the hospital post-stroke, but devising a long-term plan so he can age at home.

We’re doing this covered by insurance to ensure we can serve every family in America that needs us. Aging is a universal, human experience we all will face, and we all deserve to face it with dignity and support.

Our brand promise

We are in the business of trust.

Hera’s brand promise is simple: care that would only be great enough for our own parents. This promise is our moat.

It’s what physicians refer to, families buy, what Heroes deliver, and what the product must unlock and enforce at every touchpoint.

The supply challenge and our biggest bottleneck

There aren’t enough experts to serve every family who needs us. The bottleneck isn’t demand, it’s supply.

Today we need our Heroes to have years of social work or nursing expertise, the ability to build trust and the operational excellence to execute quickly. This is rare. Only 1 in every 200 social workers we interview becomes a Hero.

But that’s not enough Heroes for every family in America to have one.

In order to scale to all of America, we need to unbundle expertise from the human and broaden the aperture of who can become a Hero. Anyone that can foster human connection should be able to become a Hero with Hera. In that world, our supply challenge becomes how we uphold quality across every human touch point with our customers.

Join our Founding Team to impact real lives

We are looking for ambitious and relentless engineers to join us on this mission. Whereas at other companies you may be working on the next widget, analytics suite, dev tooling, or b2b revolution, what we are trying to do is as tangible as it gets. We serve the everyday people in society that are most sorely in need of help and who have been least addressed by the technological revolution and developer brainpower of the past decades. We want to bring the highest quality builders to bear on this.

Our entire team is truth seeking. This means we are side by side with our Heroes everyday, learning what it takes to do the job and do it well.

We are high autonomy and trust. there is no space for micromanagement, if you see a problem or think of a solution, you are empowered to run at it wholeheartedly and know that the team has your back.

We are creative in our bones. For the first time in many years, we are seeing the genesis of a new profession of a profound scale and importance; it’s on us to define what it can and should look like.

When you solve a hard problem, you will know that you’ve empowered some of the most selfless members of our society to tangibly impact the lives of some of those most in need. You will also be rewarded with harder problems. Our promise is we will stretch your limits, and trust you to own unreasonably substantial outcomes.

If this excites you and these values speak to you, let’s talk: myles@hellohera.com.

In a world of growing cynicism we chase hard truths, give a damn, and build.

About the current team

You’ll be building Hera alongside co-founders Jenny, Myles & Connie as well as founding team member Isabella, Sasi, Dan. Jenny, Connie, Isabella & Dan were in the trenches together building Headway (now the largest mental health platform in America) while Myles, Sasi & Connie all came from Palantir, all resonating with a personal tie to this mission.

We closed a sizable seed round led by Accel and have since gotten to seven-figure GMV with organic distribution through channel partners: geriatricians and social workers from Weill Cornell, NYU Langone and Mt Sinai. The customer feedback is the most positive our team has seen in our careers. Read our story and watch our launch video here.

We are in person in NYC.

jobs.title: Onboarding Guide (Patient Enrollment)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
A doctor refers a family to Hera. They're cautiously optimistic but mostly overwhelmed - they've been bounced between systems, handed pamphlets, told to "call this number." They don't know what geriatric care management is. They definitely don't know it's covered by Medicare. They're one confusing phone call away from saying "never mind, we'll figure it out ourselves."

You're the reason they don't.

As an Onboarding Guide, you're the first voice a family hears from Hera. You help them understand how Hera competently cares for their parents, walk them through every step of getting started, and hand them off to their Hero feeling confident, heard, and ready. You're part closer, part concierge, part care coordinator. You just make the path so clear and the experience so easy that saying yes feels obvious.

This role sits at the intersection of relationship-building and operations. You're selling, but what you're selling is something families genuinely need, and your job is to remove every obstacle between a referral and a first appointment. Missing paperwork, skeptical adult children, a patient who's never used a computer - you will get through whatever it takes so that the family can meet their Hero.

Your mission as the Onboarding Guide

  • You're the reason families actually get help instead of falling through the cracks between referral and care

  • You aren’t just going through a motion. You're building trust with real families at a vulnerable moment

  • You own the full onboarding experience, no handing things off and hoping for the best

  • You leverage technology to make onboarding seamless, not a stack of faxes and voicemails

  • Elevate your ceiling. We're early stage and growing fast - Guides joining now are shaping how every future family experiences Hera

The Role

  • 1099 flexibility, 30–40 hrs/week in business hours EST (you set your schedule)

  • $25-30/hour base + enrollment bonuses (top performers earn $40-50/hour)

  • Be the first point of contact after a doctor refers a family to Hera - guide them from "what is Hera?" to their first Hero appointment

  • Remote - must be located in the United States

What you'll actually do

  • Convert referrals into active clients by helping families understand what Hera is and how we can be valuable in their care journey

  • Guide families through the onboarding process - paperwork, documentation, insurance verification, scheduling - so nothing stalls

  • Coordinate between families and Hera's care team to ensure a clean handoff to their matched Hero

  • Help families navigate technology: uploading documents, joining telehealth appointments, signing e-forms

  • Spot friction in the intake process and fix it - not just for one family, but for every family after them

  • Collaborate with our engineering team to streamline workflows and scale how many families we can onboard without sacrificing quality

You'd be a great fit if you

  • Have a background in healthcare sales, care coordination, or customer success — especially with older adults or their families

  • Are warm on the phone and sharp on the follow-through. Families trust you quickly and nothing falls through the cracks

  • Think "how do I get this from 2 hours to 15 minutes" without cutting corners

  • Hold yourself to a high bar: done right, not just done

  • Are tech-savvy and energized by fast-moving environments where the playbook is still being written

We're on a mission to change the way we care for our parents and redefine a universal human experience. Watch our launch video here.

jobs.title: Clinical NP/PA/MD — Geriatric Care
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Hera is dedicated care management in the community for older adults, covered by Medicare. Every family gets matched with a dedicated Hero, you, who actually has the tools, time, and autonomy to help. It’s real, ongoing support where you see things through.

The Role

We're building the clinical infrastructure that makes great geriatric care exceptional. You'd be one of the founding members of our clinical team in new states, shaping how we assess, support, and coordinate care as we launch and grow.


As a clinical NP/PA/MD, you'll conduct telehealth assessments that set the foundation for months of coordinated geriatric care. Each 45–60 minute visit is a clinical gateway: confirming Medicare eligibility, synthesizing complex medical and social history, identifying the barriers to treatment, and establishing the trust that families need to engage fully. This is clinical work that matters. Every assessment informs the entire care strategy.


Requirements

  • Licensed NP, PA, or MD (must be able to practice in one of the following states: NJ, MD, PA, MA, CA, FL)

  • Substantial experience in geriatric primary care, transitions of care, or chronic disease management

  • Confident in telehealth assessment and skilled at building trust and clinical rapport across a screen

  • Strong clinical judgment, excellent communication, and comfort with complexity and ambiguity

  • Aligned with our mission: you see older adults as deserving of excellent, attentive care


Compensation

  • $65 - $175 / hr depending on license type, location and years of experience


Hours/Schedule

  • 3–10+ hours per week to support case load of 40+ clients, flexible

  • Weekday 11am–4pm ET preferred but can self-select working hours
